title: Invisible TAB name
description: This mod do that if you have invisibility effect then it overwrite your name in TAB with Invisible Player
body:
Invisible Tab Name is a server-side Fabric mod that integrates with the TAB mod to improve how invisible players are displayed in the tab list.

When a player receives the Invisibility status effect, their real username is hidden from the tab list (online players list).
Instead, the name is replaced with:

Invisible Player

As soon as the invisibility effect expires or is removed, the player’s original nickname is automatically restored.

Features
Server-side only (no client installation required)

Fabric mod

Requires TAB mod

Hides player names in the tab list while invisible

Replaces the name with "Invisible Player"

Automatically updates when invisibility is gained or lost

Lightweight and performance-friendly
